name: Unmei no Furiko ~Pendulum of Fate~
original_name: 運命の振り子 ～Pendulum of Fate～
source:
A casual town built around a coeducational school. Main character lines in the shrine on the outskirts of the town. There is a poorly known Norther Europe prophecy that this weekend a great danger should befall upon the world. Will hero be able to save the humanity or the Earth is doomed?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一座平凡小镇以男女合校的学校为中心发展。主角住在镇郊的神社。鲜为人知的北欧预言宣称，这个周末世界将遭遇巨大危机。主角能否拯救人类，还是地球注定毁灭？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-may-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
